description: Dear Neighbor,This month, we delivered meaningful wins for Onslow County — from passing a responsible state budget that invests in our community, to advancing legislation that strengthens our Second Amendment rights and public safety.Whether it’s securing $5 million for the New River YMCA Aquatic Center, or standing with our veterans at Camp Lejeune, I’m focused on real solutions that reflect our values and priorities.As always, my office is here to serve you. Please don’t hesitate to reach out
title: The Onslow Observer: State Budget, Constitutional Carry, & More...
